title: Danversport

services.name: Harborview Ballroom
services.desc: All it takes is a single step inside the Harborview Ballroom to feel the magnificence of the room. Light glitters in every corner of the North Shore’s largest ballroom from two grand crystal chandeliers. The accompanying deck provides guests wonderful views of Danversport’s Porter River. Your special event, no matter the cause, is sure to be spectacular and forever cherished. For events that do not need the entire Harborview Ballroom, dividers in the room can be closed to create a more intimate space in the back portion of the room along the windows and deck. No matter the event, Danversport’s waterfront Harborview Ballroom is an iconic setting your guests are sure to remember. Step inside

services.name: Terrace Ballroom & Gardens
services.desc: Indoors, the Terrace Ballroom comes complete with a large dance floor, beautiful floor-to-ceiling mirrors, and a striking marble bar. Outside the Terrace doors are over 4,000 square feet of outdoor garden space punctuated by a picturesque waterfront pergola. This venue has the perfect mix of indoor and outdoor space available, and your guests will feel comfortable easily transitioning between the gorgeous event space to the stunning grounds. This ballroom accommodates 100-225 guests and still has plenty of space for mingling and dancing. services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Are you in charge of putting together your company’s corporate event? Whether you’re throwing a client-focused business meeting, employee appreciation party, or networking conference, you’ll want to make sure that your event is a truly unforgettable experience, meeting all of your event goals. Looking for a smaller venue for an off-site retreat or meeting? Danversport also has the space to get your team away from the distractions of the office. Whether you envision a fundraising gala in the Harborview Ballroom or an intimate lecture series with a select group of invitees, Danversport’s corporate event venues transform and adapt to your needs. services.name: Tasting Dinners
services.desc: These chef-curated courses are not regularly available on any of Danversport’s menus. Our culinary team takes great pride in preparing these elegant multi-course experiences. Each menu item and beverage pairing is carefully selected to bring out the full flavor profile of its respective partner. Tasting dinners are open to the public and are held in Danversport’s waterfront event space overlooking the Porter River. Guests do not need to have an event booked or have a marina membership to attend. However, due to the highly specialized nature of the menu, space is limited and a reservation is required.
